recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future desire to propagate external code-system copyright onto core ValueSet wrappers should be handled as a separate terminology/publication policy decision, not as a FHIR-38798 correction.
issue_request: FHIR-38798 was a Published/Persuasive R5 Patient Administration change request to remove the IHE copyright statement from the Endpoint connection type value set because the underlying endpoint-connection-type code system no longer had IHE content.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by commit f1e78b33637c0369aa8ba1ab2db29ee9081a241c, which removed the single IHE copyright element from source/endpoint/valueset-endpoint-connection-type.xml. The current file still has no ValueSet-level copyright and composes from http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/endpoint-connection-type.
additional_context: FHIR-36589 and UP-344 are the earlier Endpoint terminology change family that moved IHE connection-type concepts out of the core R5 context. FHIR-39600 and UP-529 later restored deprecated IHE concepts and the IHE copyright in THO for R4/R4B compatibility, but current core build output still has no copyright on http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/endpoint-connection-type while the referenced THO CodeSystem carries the IHE licensing notice.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the active core Endpoint value set source already reflects the FHIR-38798 removal and later IHE licensing is represented in the external THO CodeSystem rather than the core ValueSet wrapper.

related_jiras.note: Established the R5 Endpoint.connectionType terminology redesign, including CodeableConcept/example binding and removal of IHE concepts from the core R5 value set context.
Implemented PA-approved THO terminology changes that removed IHE codes from endpoint-connection-type, creating the condition FHIR-38798 cleaned up in core.
Later Applied issue requesting restoration of deprecated IHE endpoint codes for R4/R4B compatibility in THO, not a current core source change.
Implemented the FHIR-39600 THO cleanup by adding deprecated IHE concepts and the IHE copyright to the external endpoint-connection-type CodeSystem.
